From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-07T15:46:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Quick demo — 30m (Calendly link)

On it — sending manual invite and short notes.

Jonas / Camila, summary of what I did (so we have an internal record):
- Created an .ics with a single VEVENT using DTSTART/DTEND + TZID: Europe/Stockholm. That avoids ambiguous UTC offsets during DST transitions.
- Hosted .ics file: redwood-demo-STH-20271110.ics (attached)
- For Google users who see duplicate invites: ask them to remove the auto-added Calendly event and add the attached .ics manually. The duplicate often happens when Calendly sends both a calendar invitation and an email with an .ics attachment; Google sometimes adds both.
- Chili Piper note: you can append ?tz=Europe/Stockholm to the scheduling link to pre-select timezone for attendees if using our Chili Piper widget. For example: https://go.redwood.ai/demo?tz=Europe/Stockholm — that has helped avoid the auto-detect mismatch for some folks.

Email I’ll send to Anna (copied below) — feel free to edit before I send:
